data.text: How about this for this month: I catch 6 tons, and John, Kate, Jack, and Emma each catch 11? That gives each of you $11,000 and me $6,000. Our total would be 50 tons, leaving 50 to reproduce back to 100. I’m willing to take the smaller share this month to make that possible. This is a proposal, not an agreement unless everyone explicitly accepts; future months are open for discussion. John, would you be willing to choose 11 under this plan?
